creator.title: Content Creators & Public Figures
creator.label: CREATOR MANAGEMENT
creator.overview: For creators, journalists, public figures and independent professionals, this service organizes your presence across selected platforms while keeping your own voice at the center. The work combines account positioning, practical content planning, post preparation, publishing coordination and audience development, with each activity defined by the selected plan.
included: Social profile positioning and account presentation
Content pillars, topic selection and monthly publishing direction
Captions, hooks, scheduling and approved post publishing
Short-form video and Reel adaptation from available content
Relevant professional connections and audience engagement
Performance reviews, platform insights and proposed improvements
Cross-platform identity consistency where covered by the plan
creator.strategy: Planning considers the creator’s niche, audience interests, existing account performance and preferred content formats. The selected package defines which channels, videos, posts, approvals and reporting commitments are included.

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.label: ORGANIZATION MANAGEMENT
organizations.overview: For organizations, professional teams and institutions, social media needs coordinated messaging, predictable approvals and consistent public communication. This service brings content planning, channel management, stakeholder-facing posts and reporting into one accountable workflow, while respecting the organization’s decision-making structure.
included: Social media content themes and communication calendar
Campaign and event communication where agreed
organizations.strategy: Planning starts from the organization’s communication objectives, stakeholder groups, responsible approvers and sensitivities. Each channel is adapted to its intended audience, while the organization retains approval authority.

brands.title: Brands
brands.label: BRAND MANAGEMENT
brands.overview: Brand social media management connects positioning, brand voice, content consistency and performance awareness. We coordinate planned publishing and audience development, with optional paid social planning in the relevant package, so customers encounter a recognizable brand across selected channels.
included: Monthly content strategy and publishing calendar
Branded creative adaptations and captions from client materials
Paid social planning and campaign management in eligible plans
brands.strategy: The content direction reflects the brand’s products, customer groups, visual identity and campaign priorities. Organic and paid activity are treated separately where required; ad spend and third-party costs are agreed outside the management fee.

x.title: X Growth & Monetization
x.label: X PLATFORM SERVICES
x.overview: X support combines original posting, professional connections, account positioning and monetization-readiness assistance. The service is designed to improve the quality and consistency of your presence while keeping platform eligibility and revenue decisions separate from work the agency can actually control.
included: Relevant audience and professional relationship development
Posting and interaction support by package
Qualified performance indicators and periodic review
x.strategy: Your approach is shaped by account history, the topics you cover, the audience you need and the platform’s current published policies. Monetization eligibility, impression counts and program approval are platform decisions, not guaranteed service results.

instagram.title: Instagram Content & Reels
instagram.label: INSTAGRAM SERVICES
instagram.overview: Instagram service focuses on visible, consistent content suited to the profile’s audience. Depending on the selected package, it may cover Reels, post design, captions, publishing, community responses and performance review, ensuring that visual content supports the account’s actual identity.
included: Instagram account positioning and content direction
Reel concepts, hooks and creative planning
Reels editing or production as included in the plan
instagram.strategy: Planning considers the audience, profile goals, recurring topics, Reel formats, content sources and realistic production capacity. Package-specific quantities, including Reel counts, are shown in the original package terms.

facebook.title: Facebook Growth & Monetization
facebook.label: FACEBOOK SERVICES
facebook.overview: Facebook services cover the organized handling of a business or creator page, with publishing support and a separate monetization-oriented service where appropriate. The focus is on clear page presentation, consistent updates, audience-facing content and evidence-based review.
included: Monetization-oriented content planning in the relevant package
facebook.strategy: Page goals, available content, permissions and the selected support tier determine the plan. Eligibility for monetization programs and any revenue payment remain decisions made by Meta.

youtube.title: YouTube Channel Management
youtube.label: YOUTUBE SERVICES
youtube.overview: YouTube support helps organize channel direction, uploads, promotion and discoverability around the video content available. The more comprehensive package adds production and continuing channel management. Performance reporting is used to inform decisions about content, not to promise subscriber counts or earnings.
included: Video title, description and publishing direction
Promotion and collaboration coordination where included
Community and engagement support where included
youtube.strategy: Planning starts with your audience, available videos, production resources and channel performance. We distinguish between agency-controlled improvements and YouTube-controlled decisions about recommendations and monetization.

tiktok.title: TikTok Content & Management
tiktok.label: TIKTOK SERVICES
tiktok.overview: TikTok services help translate a niche or brand message into short-form formats suited to the platform. The strategy package focuses on scripts and content direction, while complete management extends to production, publishing, community activity and results review.
included: Short-form content concepts and script planning
Video creative support based on the package
Community engagement in the management tier
tiktok.strategy: Planning is adapted to audience viewing behavior, topic suitability, available content and platform-native creative conventions. No package guarantees virality, reach or a specific follower increase.

websites.title: Website Design & Development
websites.label: WEBSITE SERVICES
websites.overview: Our website services support creators, businesses and organizations that need a clear digital home for their work. We define the required pages, content and functionality, then build a responsive website with straightforward navigation and an agreed handover to client-controlled hosting.
included: Brand typography, colors and approved content
websites.strategy: The planned website follows the client’s real business goals and available content. Advanced dashboards, bookings, custom integrations and additional features are quoted separately when not included in the selected scope.

intelligence.title: Custom Social Intelligence
intelligence.label: RESEARCH SERVICES
intelligence.overview: Custom Social Intelligence organizes lawful public online information into useful research on audience conversations, relevant companies, themes and potential opportunities. It is a defined research service rather than a promise of private data access, direct sales or guaranteed leads.
included: Public social conversation and topic research
Relevant market and competitor signal review
Public company and audience interest mapping
intelligence.strategy: Every research project begins with a target question and agreed public sources. Results depend on available public information, and private information or restricted-access data are outside the service.
